decision.title: Live and in Session
tracklist: You Need Me, I Don't Need You (Live and in Session)
The A Team (Live and in Session)
I See Fire (Live and in Session)

rationale: Discography populator: full tracklist (5 tracks) per https://albumblitz.com/ed-sheeran-live-and-in-session/, https://lyrics.rare-lyrics.com/artist/19. 2014 live digital EP (Atlantic) tied to 'x' promotion. NOT 6 tracks: 5 live tracks confirmed by three indexes (albumblitz.com, rare-lyrics.com, daletra.net); a fourth (rclyricsband.com) lists only 4, apparently missing 'You Need Me, I Don't Need You'. Order follows albumblitz (numbered tracks with durations, cover art sourced from Spotify); rare-lyrics lists the same 5 tracks in a different (likely alphabetical) order. One AI-generated page claimed 4 tracks - excluded as unreliable.
